day.description: The UTC day counted, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must equal the date in the record key.

routes.description: One entry per route the client had a proxy open for.

subject.description: The client's DID. Must equal the DID in the record key.

countsLost.description: True when the provider may have lost some of the day's counts, as after an unclean exit. This may result in published figures being too low, but never too high.

main.description: The traffic a Provider believes it carried for one Client in one UTC day. The client can verify against its own count. Providers use the record key <YYYY-MM-DD>~<client DID>.

route.description: The at-uri of the client's link.jetbridge.route record, which must be in the client's own repo.

egress.description: Bytes, not megabytes, sent from the Client to visitors via the Provider.

ingress.description: Bytes, not megabytes, sent from visitors to the client.

connections.description: How many visitor TCP connections closed on this day.
